purpose: Atomic condition-branch catalog for Unit Test EN v0.5 planning. Test level prevents component, contract, and BTP integration checks from being mislabeled as pure unit tests.

testLevelDefinitions.PURE_UNIT: Isolated deterministic helper/module test without CAP persistence or network.
testLevelDefinitions.UI_COMPONENT: Client-side SAPUI5 behavior validated without claiming an equivalent backend rule.
testLevelDefinitions.CAP_COMPONENT: CAP handler/helper test with controlled transaction and local or hybrid persistence.
testLevelDefinitions.ODATA_CONTRACT: HTTP/OData contract test including status, payload, authorization, and side effects.
testLevelDefinitions.BTP_INTEGRATION: Acceptance that depends on deployed XSUAA, HANA, S3, Job Scheduler, Brevo, or live AI Gateway.

environmentDefinitions.LOCAL: Runs entirely on the local controlled test stack.
environmentDefinitions.HYBRID_BTP: Runs locally first and is repeated on BTP/HANA for persistence or role evidence.
environmentDefinitions.BTP_REQUIRED: Cannot be accepted locally because it depends on a bound SAP BTP or live external service.

evidencePolicy.rule: Command-only, script-only, or shared screenshot-only evidence is not sufficient.
